name: io.github.ni-c/ntfy-mcp
title: ntfy
description: Publish ntfy notifications, read the message cache, and manage users and topic access

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the ntfy server, e.g. https://ntfy.example.net. There is deliberately no default.

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: ntfy access token (tk_...). Optional: an open instance needs no credentials. Mutually exclusive with NTFY_USERNAME/NTFY_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for basic authentication. Must be set together with NTFY_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for basic authentication. Must be set together with NTFY_USERNAME.

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_TOPICS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated topics the server may use. The first is the default when a tool omits one, and the list restricts every read and write tool.

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to exactly true to register only the six read tools (default: false — ntfy exists to publish)

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate from the ntfy server (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: NTFY_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left
